name: t3n-invoice-clerk
description: Enterprise vendor invoice intake agent on Terminal 3 (T3N). Ledger lines only — never payment authority. Testnet, free-token path.

scripts.check:card: node --input-type=module -e "import {statSync} from 'node:fs'; const n=statSync('src/agent/agent-card.json').size; if(n>16384){console.error('agent-card.json is '+n+' bytes (limit 16 KiB)'); process.exit(1);} console.log('agent-card.json '+n+' bytes (<16 KiB)');"
